global: Three caravans hit by bandits on the north road this week. Insurance is not a real thing here, apparently.
Tolls at the {town} bridge went up again. Nobody asked the people actually paying them, mind.
{rival} undercut my spice prices by half. Either they found a secret supply or they're just losing money on purpose.
Whoever balanced iron ore spawns, I'd like a word. Mining three days for one ingot is not a trade route.
Bandits on the coast road again. I'd pay a guard fee gladly if anyone sold one that actually shows up.
Lost a whole wagon of salt to the swamp path ambush. Lovely. Next time I bring the tax collector along for company.
Grain prices in {town} are a joke. Someone is cornering the market and I'd love to know who.
The new toll on the river crossing means every cart loses a third of its profit before it even moves. Dreadful.
Honest question for the devs: why does a sack of flour weigh more than a horse? My back disagrees with the balance.
{faction} wants the mountain pass closed for their war. Wonderful. My cloth is sitting in a warehouse rotting.
